Using your Charged Melee Ability while sliding launches an Arc Uppercut that travels 22 meters and Jolts all enemies hit. Grants 75% damage resistance against Combatants for 4 seconds after cast.
Tempest Strike can consume and receive the benefits of Combination Blow and Lethal Current's aftershock.
Firing your weapon during the slide disables this ability.

[Melee Ability] performs an uppercut, launching an Arc Wave along the ground up to 22 metres away, dealing 739 [125] damage and inflicting Jolt.

src.bungie: Quickly evade in a lateral direction.
src.clarity:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs a quick, first-person, 8 meter dash in your current input direction. Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles (needs confirmation) and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.
Not inputting a movement direction results in a 4 meter backwards dash.

src.bungie:
Your Flashbang, Pulse, Lightning, and Storm Grenades have enhanced functionality.

Flashbang Grenade: Emits an additional blinding detonation on bounce.

Pulse Grenade: Creates Ionic Traces periodically as it damages targets and increases in damage over time.

Lightning Grenade: Grants an additional grenade charge, jolts targets hit by the initial blast, and grants Bolt Charge when it causes damage.

Storm Grenade: After detonating, creates a roaming thundercloud that tracks nearby targets and fires bolts of lightning at foes beneath it.
src.clarity:
Enhances your Flashbang, Lightning, Pulse, and Storm Grenade Abilities:
• Flashbang Grenade releases a full damage Blinding pulse in a 5 meter radius of its first impact with a surface
• Lightning Grenade grants an additional Grenade Ability charge. Each pulse Jolts targets and grants x5 Bolt Charge
• Pulse Grenade creates an Ionic Trace on hit (1 second cooldown), and deals 2%|9%|18.5%|24%|25% increased damage on the 1|2|3|4|5th pulse. Deals 25% increased damage on all pulses after the 5th
• Storm Grenade turns into a roaming 'Storm Cloud' that lasts 4.5 seconds and fires 11 lightning bolts over its lifetime (6 seconds and 15 bolts with Spark of Amplitude). Storm Cloud moves at a starting rate of 2.7 [1.5] meters per second, then doubles its speed over 1.6? seconds
src.compendium: Explodes an additional time on impact, dealing up to 684 [?] damage over 7.5 meters and inflicting blind to enemies within 5 meters.
